newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Qingling details US$100 mln bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Qingling details US$100 mln bond issue.

text.p: Qingling Motors Co Ltd said on Thursday it has agreed to issue a US$100 million principal amount of 3.5 percent convertible bonds due 2002 that can be convertible into new H-shares of the company.
The Chinese carmaker said it has granted managers of the issue an over-allotment option to require Qingling to issue an additional US$10 million of the bonds.

Interest payment dates will be on January 22 of each year starting in 1998, with maturity on January 22, 2002. Each bond will be convertible into company H-shares at an initial conversion price of HK$4.50 per share subject to adjustment, it said.
Assuming full conversion of the bonds, the company will be required to issue 171.98 million new H-shares, or 7.9 percent of its enlarged issued share capital, it said.
Application has been made to list the bonds on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange.
Qingling said net proceeds would be used to establish production of a new model of Isuzu's T-Series pick-up truck and modified multi-purpose passenger and cargo vehicles based on it.

Earlier this week, Qingling posted an unaudited net profit of 309.23 million yuan for the first nine months of 1996, up from 89.90 million yuan in the same period a year earlier. Turnover rose to 2.80 billion yuan in the 1996 period from 2.25 billion yuan a year earlier.
